general.moduleInfo: General settings defines this fleet’s name, time zone, date format and display units. You can set fuel and reporting thresholds and notification retention. The speed limit is a stored reference and does not change speeding alerts. Display preferences keep stored measurements and the explicitly labeled units in forms and filters unchanged.
